Unzip hiraeth.zip, open the folder in RStudio, then run:

```{r}
packageVersion("rlang")   # should now say 1.3.0
library(devtools)
install.packages(c("devtools", "usethis", "gitcreds"))
devtools::document()   # builds the help pages from the roxygen comments
devtools::check()      # aim for 0 errors, 0 warnings
```
```{r}
usethis::use_git_config(user.name = "Gemma Rees", user.email = "gemmarees7@gmail.com")
usethis::create_github_token()   # opens GitHub: keep the default scopes, generate, copy the token
gitcreds::gitcreds_set()         # paste the token when prompted
```

```{r}
usethis::use_git()      # starts version control and makes the first commit; say yes to restart RStudio
usethis::use_github()   # creates GREES27/hiraeth on GitHub and pushes everything
```

```{r}
devtools::install_github("GREES27/hiraeth")
```

```{r}
devtools::document()
devtools::check()
```
